data.text: Pagination is not just about splitting results — it's about doing so efficiently. Without proper indexes and query shaping, pagination can become a performance bottleneck.
Database indexes are the most important factor in pagination performance. Ensure your ORDER BY columns are indexed.

data.title: SQL Index
data.content: Create an index for cursor pagination on Id.

data.text: Keyset pagination (a form of cursor pagination) uses the last seen values instead of OFFSET. It's much faster for deep pages.

data.title: Keyset Query
data.content: Use WHERE with the last seen values.

data.text: When paginating related data, use `[UseProjection]` or `[UseSelection]` to let Hot Chocolate optimize the query.

data.title: Projection with Pagination
Watch Out For
data.text: OFFSET becomes slower as the page number increases because the database must still scan and discard rows. Keyset pagination avoids this by using indexed WHERE clauses.

terms.definition: Pagination based on the values of the last row seen, not on a page number.
A data structure that improves query speed on database columns.
When fetching a list and then fetching each item's relations one by one, causing N+1 queries.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Index ORDER BY columns for fast pagination
Use projection to reduce data transfer
Profile queries with real data volumes
